about_the_game:
The beloved neighborhood bookshop you grew up in has lost its owner. You take a gamble on life and decide to embrace your love for books. You quit your city job and decide to do this full time, now, it's up to you to rebuild and reimagine the space.

Manage your bookshop, nurture rising authors, host community showcases, and as your store's reputation grows, invite literary legends. Expand across cities—and maybe, one day, open branches on other planets. *Wink*

Manage Shop

  • Inventory System: Restock books and manage supply-demand cycles.

  • Sales Mechanics: Earn revenue through customer interactions and successful transactions.

  • Dialogue System: Engage in conversations with authors, agents, and publishing houses.

  • Reputation Meter: Grow and track your store’s credibility and influence.


Customize

  • Interior Decoration: Change walls, floors, and store themes.

  • Furniture Placement: Move shelves, tables, and seating to enhance customer comfort.

  • Decorative Items: Unlock and place items that improve ambience and customer happiness.

Scale the Business

  • Multi-location Expansion: Purchase and manage new bookstores in different cities—or planets!

  • Mini-games Integration: Unlock new areas and rewards through cozy casual games (e.g., match-3 puzzles).

  • Progression System: Gradually unlock new gameplay layers, features, and challenges as your store evolves.

Dynamic Environment

  • Day/Night Cycle: Time flows naturally, affecting lighting, customer footfall, and special events.

  • Weather System: Rain, fog, and cozy overcast days add variety, charm, and new customer behaviors.

  • Lo-fi Music: A soothing lo-fi soundtrack complements the changing atmosphere and cozy gameplay loop.

Learn & Grow

  • Discover Original Works: Read short poems, book excerpts, and plot teasers shared by visiting in-game authors.

  • Collectibles Library: Save and collect these writings in your personal "Notebook" or "Shelf of Stories"—curating a growing literary archive.

  • Unlock Classics: Reach milestones to unlock iconic poems and excerpts from real-world authors and poets.

  • Knowledge + Nostalgia: A feature that rewards curiosity, celebrates creativity, and deepens the player’s connection to literature.

Not just a bookstore—it's a place to learn, reflect, grow, and carry stories with you.

Join us in our journey and stay connected by following us on our socials.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 (64-bit) or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD 630 or Better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Graphics: GTX 1050 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

short_description: A cozy bookshop management sim where you run, customize, and expand your dream bookstore. Restock shelves, host author events, play mini-games, and collect literary works as you grow your reputation across cities, and maybe even planets.
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Czech, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Traditional Chinese, Ukrainian
*languages with full audio support
